findings.text: UiSystem stores dependencies.Wait but does not pass it to WindowNavigator.new; instead it passes Wait to WindowAssetLoader, whose dependency contract does not consume it. Therefore the public UiSystem construction path silently falls back to RBXScriptSignal:Wait in WindowNavigator even when a deterministic Clock/Spawn/Delay/Wait scheduler is injected. The TS-TEST-009 fixture constructs WindowNavigator directly, so it does not observe this composition defect. Forward self._wait to WindowNavigator (and keep loader dependencies honest) so the absolute-deadline seam is exercised through the production composition path.
